column2: A clown appears at your court.
My faith calls me to refine my spirit, for a soul left idle withers. Yet as I prepare to withdraw in contemplation, my thoughts return to the realm I rule. Can I truly afford such absence?
No. The realm needs me now.

[Root.GetJobSpiritual.GetTitledFirstName] places a small carved token in your palm. My lord, when you take your retreat, pray to Soma, that your thoughts become clear and your plans outlast the chaos of the moment.
Your reminder is... timely. I will not ignore it.
I will offer my thoughts where I judge them most needed.
